note: Recognition rules and fingerprints for ARRI's free look packages. Names, sizes, LUT sizes and SHA-256 only; never LUT data. Filled by tools/looks/fingerprint.py in M3-09 (HUMAN M3-H2). See docs/08-looks.md.
patterns_note: Checked on 2026-10-15 against the text of ARRI's Look Files page (https://www.arri.com/en/learn/camera-systems/image-science/look-files, pasted by Mykyta) and one real download: 'ARRI Look Library LogC4 (log-to-log) 3D-LUTs_data.zip' (190 MB, 87 cubes of 65 points). The page lists 'Look Library for LogC4 (3D-LUTs)' (log-to-log, 2025-07-30), 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (3D-LUTs)' (log-to-log, 2024-11-28), 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (to Rec709) 3D-LUTs' (33 mesh points, 2024-03-12) and two camera look-file packages that Yellowmoon cannot import: 'Look Library for LogC4 (ALF4 Look Files)' (.alf4, 2023-02-10) and 'ARRI Look Library LogC3 (Look Files)' (.aml, 2023-02-10). It states no download sizes and no LUT size for the LogC3 log-to-log library, so neither is a rule (download_mb is a hint; that library's lut_sizes is empty). The two display LUT packages are on ARRI's Technical Downloads page, not on that page; their names ('LogC4 LUT Package'), counts and file naming (ARRI_LogC4-to-Gamma24_Rec709-D65_v1_65.cube) come from ARRI's LUT naming guideline and were not checked against a download. How the patterns are used: the zip_name patterns, the encoding and the LUT sizes identify a package as a whole (at least half of expected.cube_files files); group_folders and display_rendering are only read for files whose zip name says nothing, and then between packages that both fit. Counts are expected values, not gates: more files than expected are imported with a note, fewer are reported as an incomplete download. Download sizes are not used to recognise anything. Once tools/looks/fingerprint.py has filled 'fingerprints' (HUMAN M3-H2), files are identified by hash and these patterns only cover files that are not in a fingerprint list.
